intro: Delicate Instruments is a quest in eastern Elwynn Forest focused on restoring magical stability to the Tower of Azora. Hamish Bergwort's sensitive equipment is being disrupted by erratic spellcasting practiced by nearby Defias rogue wizards. Resolving the disturbance requires putting an end to the amateur sorcery around Stone Cairn Lake.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.

This is most frustrating, friend. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, friend.
